dream: I pressed the flat rock down until the heat blurred the edge into nothing. The Tired Wedge sat in the middle of a box that leaned too far. I swapped the light wood for a heavy stump, but the card hummed warm and crowded, making the air feel thick as wet paper. The slip refused to stop sliding under the weight. I leaned my heavy hands against the wrong line, pressing harder until the flat stone bit deep or simply dissolved into a drawing that finally made sense.
